scope: Static injector equation and characterization closure; no executable calibration output
conclusions: Raw equations, table encodings, interpolation and the two differently-scaled standard-flow families are now recoverable offline. The XDF six-decimal standard-flow equations are lossy; they must not be treated as exact physical conversion factors.

2b24 is constructed from calibrated nominal fuel pressure, an ambient-derived pressure state and a voltage/fuel-demand correction. This reviewed injector path does not consume a live rail-pressure sensor. A falling or inadequate real rail pressure can therefore remain absent from its pressure correction.

1fb4 is no longer a wholly untraced voltage candidate: canonical code derives it from eight samples of acquisition channel0x17. Its engineering voltage intent is corroborated by shared voltage axes and host A2L; actual pin/divider accuracy and voltage at the energized injector remain physical evidence gaps.

ip_ti_add_dly is a one-dimensional voltage addend, not a pressure-voltage surface. Its pressure dependence cannot be filled from two FIC pressure rows without an explicit reference and approximation/architecture decision.

ip_ti_min is a post-addend minimum over preliminary electrical-duration-domain values: the code shifts all selected cylinder pulses by the same positive delta. It is not a short-pulse correction curve and not a per-cylinder max(pulse,min) clamp.

Retained OEM documentation specifies a5bar tank regulator and non-return rail; canonical pressure table covers approximately5–6bar differential. Full OEM-topology characterization therefore requires data above4bar, including before boost. Two3/4bar rows are not sufficient for that envelope.
No flash-ready values, vehicle actions, numerical test scenarios, tests, builds, lints or formatters were performed.

raw_arithmetic.notation: U16 and U8 read unsigned RAM/calibration words/bytes; S16 is signed reinterpretation; SAT_U clamps0..65535; SAT_S clamps-32768..32767. All equations below retain operation order; no float replacement is implied.
raw_arithmetic.MUL15: 0040aeac(a,b)=min(65535,((u32)(a*b))>>15). Unsigned halfword operands here do not overflow u32.
raw_arithmetic.RMD: 0040b46c(a,b,d)=min(65535,floor(u32(a*b+floor(d/2))/d)); d=0 returns65535. Used with d=16384,4096,32768,4096 in main pulse.
raw_arithmetic.ADD_U: 0040a694(a,b)=min(65535,a+b) for the nonnegative operands here; it is NOT a signed-add helper.
raw_arithmetic.LUT: 004097c0 uses byte axes/u16 outputs;00409920 uses u16 axes/u16 outputs. Both hold endpoint values outside their axis, return stored values on knots, and between knots use q=floor((x-x0)*65536/(x1-x0)), t=abs(y1-y0)*q, output=y0+sign(y1-y0)*((t>>16)+((t>>15)&1)). This is quantized interpolation, not real-valued interpolation followed by an arbitrary rounding rule.
raw_arithmetic.LUT2: 0040882c accepts two count-prefixed byte axes and row-major u16 outputs. First coordinate selects the row with stride equal to second-axis count. Each axis clamps at endpoints and computes floor((coordinate-low)*65536/(high-low)); exact knots have fraction0. It first interpolates along the second coordinate in each adjacent row, then interpolates those rounded row results along the first coordinate, using the same signed-difference half-up magnitude rounding as LUT. This operation order is not an arbitrary floating bilinear interpolation.

unit_derivation.mass_basis: Host A2L method116 and matching mass-calibration components; physical meaning corroboration, not permission to copy foreign A2L RAM addresses.4us per time count is supported by XDF time tables and host method127.
unit_derivation.precision_boundary: The discrepancy is explainable without measurement: A2L231 uses a rounded full-scale0.37745, while arithmetic closure gives0.3774456444363357. A2L651 retains full-scale0.754891288872672 and agrees with the doubled arithmetic scale. Use the exact binary denominators and stated mass/time engineering contract, not either rounded display slope. The equations are exact under that explicit engineering-unit convention; they do not prove actual injector flow.
unit_derivation.xdf_loss: XDF0.000006/0.000012 slopes are six-decimal approximations, about4.18% above dimensional closure; XDF displayed stock0.315858 is not the exact arithmetic-derived about0.303195ms/mg. Do not calculate target encoded words using six-decimal XDF slopes.

flow_conversion.reference_pressure: Canonical ip_fac_ti_prs unity4096 at first x1884 (~4998.93hPa) together with c_fup_nom~5000hPa and OEM5bar regulator supports a stock standard-flow reference near5bar differential. The firmware does not store a formal supplier test-pressure/temperature definition attached to c_fac_mff_ti_stnd_1.
flow_conversion.symbolic_supplier_mapping: For linear flowQ_ref in g/s, numerical mg/ms is alsoQ_ref, so ideal t_eff_ms=m_mg/Q_ref and K_ref=1/Q_ref. Using a chosen, measured differential-pressure reference and the same fluid/temperature definition, pairK_ref withF_prs(deltaP)=Q_ref/Q(deltaP). Quantize using proven raw domains and explicit unit convention only after those definitions are fixed. No encoded replacement values supplied.

pressure_equation.additional_factor: 322a is produced by0010c838 fromip_fac_ti_temp_cor(cal8459ee,descriptor8457ce,U8(1e85)); initialization0014a53c is a separate writer.3228 is pressure correction multiplied by a fuel-temperature-intent correction, not pure pressure alone.
pressure_equation.unit_derivation: Nominal and ambient pre-quarter words share fine hPa intent; quartering then rounded/8 coarsens by32. The pressure axis uses2.6533607995727473hPa/count from host method154 (XDF2.653361). Its matching fine domain is axis_scale/32=0.08291752498664835hPa/count. SUB_U compares both operands in that coarse domain. Host method155/XDF offset metadata represents pressure correction centered near32767.5 whereas executable subtracts32768: preserve half-count discrepancy, do not use display0.057hPa as intentional nonzero stock correction.
pressure_equation.physical_interpretation: Source-bound nominal+ambient+correction construction supports modeled absolute rail, and subtracting modeled manifold pressure supports modeled injector delta. Ambient2ce8 is ADC-transfer/filter/default derived, not fuel rail.6c6a is the reviewed integrated manifold-pressure model, not a newly proved boosted-capable MAP sensor. Stock-topology physical relation is deltaP=P_rail_gauge+P_ambient-P_manifold_abs, modulo head losses/corrections; firmware arithmetic is only its estimate.
pressure_equation.axis_and_reference: Raw x1884..2261 (~5..6bar),z4096..3740 withQ12 denominator4096. Below first x the stock table holds4096. Thus it cannot provide increasing time correction for boost-induced delta below the stock domain without a calibrated domain change.
pressure_equation.not_proven: Actual rail pressure, regulator tracking or sag, pressure alias accuracy and correspondence during boost cannot be recovered from firmware. Square-root flow scaling is a physical approximation, not supplied >4bar injector latency/short-pulse characterization.
pressure_equation.fuel_demand_operand: 207e is written at00479d80 in00479a7c, within the207a==2 operating-state branch and its gate/count conditions. The value combines calibrated lookup results and a saturated floor(U16(299e)*36/100) term through0040a678. Its ip_fup_cor axis has l/h intent; it is a computed fuel-demand coordinate, not a measured rail pressure. Full producer source is retained; no assumed physical alias of every upstream term is needed for this distinction.
pressure_equation.stock_map_observation: All six voltage rows in canonical ip_fup_cor contain the same six output words. Consequently, in these retained bytes its output varies with the fuel-demand axis but not with the voltage row, even though the code supplies a voltage coordinate. This is a byte observation, not a measured pressure relationship.

workbook_definition_review.authoritative_source: Supplier FIC 750-6049 workbook retained privately; its SHA-256 is retained in provenance. Neither the workbook nor extracted characterization dataset is included.
workbook_definition_review.physical_rows: The reviewed supplier workbook contains two nominal differential-pressure flow rows and voltage-dependent offset data. Numerical flow values and characterization cells are omitted because redistribution rights are not established. Cached precision does not establish measured accuracy.
workbook_definition_review.important_context_correction: A platform-specific percentage-offset block uses a normalization duration. It is not evidence of universal injector dead time or the MSV70 minimum-pulse value. Numerical normalization and cell contents are omitted.
workbook_definition_review.additional_offset_cells: Other platform-specific offset projections cover additional voltages. Their driver assumptions and measured-versus-extrapolated basis must be clarified before using them outside the supplied universal domain. Source values and cell projections are omitted.
workbook_definition_review.small_pulse_cells: The workbook labels paired small-pulse data New and Original without establishing forward versus inverse transformation, effective versus total pulse, pressure, voltage, driver or error criterion. No short-pulse lookup among the four reviewed MSV70 families consumes these pairs directly. Numerical pairs and cell coordinates are omitted.
workbook_definition_review.pressure_label_conflict: The nominal pressure row also has a second unit label that is not an exact conversion. The actual bench differential and units require clarification; numerical workbook labels and cell coordinates are omitted.
workbook_definition_review.additional_info: The workbook cites the public regulator-reference article linked below. The original review read it on 2026-09-05: it explains assumed versus actual differential pressure and platform-specific adaptation, but does not define the supplier New/Original mapping or MSV70 mappings.

citations.page28: Fuel filter and pressure regulator are at the left-hand tank service opening; N52 uses a 5 bar regulator.
citations.pages29_31: Pump delivery 95 l/h at 5 bar: generic OEM design statement, not a measurement of this pump.
citations.pages31_32: DME sends requested fuel volume; EKP maps to delivery voltage and controls pump speed from current ripple. This is not described as rail-pressure-sensor feedback.
citations.page33: Rail is non-return; injectors are supplied from Terminal 87 of the injector relay.

oem_pressure_characterization_requiremen.decision: Yes: retaining the documented OEM topology requires characterization above 4 bar differential over the actual non-boosted/high-vacuum envelope as well as the minimum boosted differential. The approximately 5..6 bar stock axis corroborates this requirement. Do not ask only for a 4 bar table because boost can lower differential pressure.
oem_pressure_characterization_requiremen.qualification: Documented 5 bar is a hardware baseline, not a measurement on this car. Exact upper/lower differential, pump/regulator identity, head loss and transients remain user/physical inputs. A genuinely constant-differential system at a verified reference within 3..4 bar could change the above-4-bar requirement; no such hardware change is assumed or recommended here.

supplier: Exact bench differential pressure and units for each supplied row; fluid identity, density and temperature; flow measurement basis; voltage at the injector; driver waveform/current; and offset definition.

Flow, voltage-dependent offsets, short-pulse and repeatability characterization above 4 bar sufficient for the retained OEM non-boosted envelope; include actual minimum boosted differential and cranking/running voltage envelope once specified. Do not extrapolate offsets using square-root flow scaling.

New/Original mapping direction; effective or total electrical duration; pressure/voltage/driver reference; whether offset is included; allowed linearity/repeatability error defining minimum usable pulse. Clarify MS3 100% normalization and the measurement or extrapolation basis of the extended Holley/MS3 voltage rows.
Per-injector serial/flow-match report if individual compensation is intended; fuel/material compatibility and electrical-driver compatibility of the delivered Bosch cores.
user_or_physical_evidence: Actual fuel topology: pump/filter/regulator part identities, reference connection and changes from OEM; fuel type and temperature envelope.

Synchronized real rail gauge or absolute pressure, ambient/manifold absolute pressure and DME pressure states to establish differential pressure and model error. The modeled DME rail state cannot replace this independent evidence.
Actual injector-terminal voltage/current waveform compared with channel-0x17-derived 1fb4 and battery supply, including harness/relay drop, driver closing behavior and latency.

Physical fitment/retention, physical cylinder-index permutation when needed, runtime operating mode and slice selectors, naturally aspirated quantity/latency performance, then boosted duty/phase feasibility. No such actions requested or performed in this review.
remaining_inputs.offline_convention_decision: Offline unit convention is now specified: mass1389/65535mg/stk per count, time1/250ms per count, wall denominator32768 and main-pulse bank denominator16384. Their rational coefficient scales are4369/758579200 and4369/379289600. A2L231 rounds its full-scale to0.37745; this explains its slight disagreement. Carry exact rational scaling into any future conversion rather than treating the six-decimal XDF slope as exact. No vehicle measurement is needed to resolve this representation issue.
remaining_inputs.mapping_architecture_decision: Choose an actual differential-pressure reference and an explicit strategy for pressure-dependent offset with the stock voltage-only addend. Four field names alone cannot exactly implement arbitrary Q(deltaP), D(V,deltaP) and nonlinear correction. Supplier definitions must precede deciding whether a bounded approximation is acceptable. No firmware proposal is made.
